description.narrative: In response to the increasing steel demand from the construction and infrastructure sectors, this project aims to catalyze the decarbonization of Indian steel production. The initiative focuses on creating an enabling environment for green steel by introducing regulatory, financial, and educational measures to integrate renewable energy and low-carbon technologies. Key actions include: 1. Implementing regulatory frameworks to support renewable energy integration; 2. Establishing innovative financing mechanisms that reduce investment risks in clean technologies; 3. Expanding the demand for and demonstration of Best Available Technologies (BATs); 4. Enhancing the knowledge and skills of industry stakeholders, including up-skilling women; 5. Demonstrating business models to boost green steel demand. The project anticipates leveraging approximately €600 million in combined private and public funding, aiming to significantly increase the adoption of low-carbon technologies in the sector.
